Which of the following could be the function that generates the vector field above?
worked_solution:
We notice the following:

- The vertical component (i.e., the $j$ component) is zero for *every* vector in our vector field. Therefore, we can rule out the following option:

$$
H(x,y)=y\,i+j
$$

- As we move away from the origin in the vertical direction, our vectors' horizontal components (i.e., the $i$ components) get longer. Therefore, we can rule out the following options:

$$
F(x,y)=x\,i,\,K(x,y)=-i
$$

Therefore, we conclude that the diagram corresponds to the vector field $G(x,y)=y\,i.$
